question.text: The average concentration of SO<sub>2</sub> in the atmosphere over a city on a certain day is 10 ppm, when the average temperature is 298 K. Given that  average solubility of SO<sub>2</sub> at 298 K is 1.3653 M atm<sup>-1</sup> and pK<sub>a</sub> of H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>3</sub> is 1.92, estimate the pH of rain on that day.

solution.text:
Partial pressure of SO2 in air = 10- 5 atm

[SO2 ]     =   1.3653 x 10- 5 M

[H2SO3 ]  =  1.3653 x 10- 5 M

  H 2 SO 3 ⇌ H + + HSO 3 -

H2SO3 at low concentration is fully ionised.

[H+ ]  =  1.3653 x 10- 5

pH    =  - log 1.3653 x 10- 5

        =  5 - log 1.36

        =  4.86
